meta.note: Status semantics, token keys and density targets come from the repo; palette, type and component treatment are a new direction (v3) that replaces v2.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind panels; the app content area.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, tables, form fields: anything that holds data.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdowns, drawers, modals and the command palette (paired with a shadow).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header row, totals row, read-only fields, inactive segments.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and menu-item hover.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected table row, current Gantt row, selected list item.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, table row dividers, section dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Group dividers, Gantt hour ticks, segmented-control outline.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, selects and secondary buttons: 3:1 against canvas and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface and every raised surface.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, column headers, labels, helper text.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps in lists, placeholder, units after numbers. Not for anything that must be read to act.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control text and icons (exempt from contrast).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Streamline cobalt (the logo blue). Primary buttons, links, selected tab indicator, focus of attention.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of brand fills and links.

tokens.name: brand-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill: selected segment, info banner, sparkline area, avatar ground.

tokens.name: brand-soft-ink
tokens.usage: Text on brand-soft.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: The navigation rail and the login brand panel: the dark frame around the work.

tokens.name: chrome-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered rail item, collapsed-rail tooltip, rail footer.

tokens.name: chrome-active
tokens.usage: Background of the current rail item.

tokens.name: chrome-line
tokens.usage: Dividers inside the rail.

tokens.name: on-chrome
tokens.usage: Rail item labels, logo lockup text on chrome.

tokens.name: on-chrome-muted
tokens.usage: Rail group labels, rail meta text, inactive icons on chrome.

tokens.name: chrome-accent
tokens.usage: Icon of the current rail item and the focus ring on chrome.

tokens.name: mark-red
tokens.usage: Streamline red from the logo stripe. Identity only: the Gantt now-line and its time flag, the cover. Never a button, never a status.

tokens.name: on-mark-red
tokens.usage: Text on a mark-red fill (the now-line time flag).

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: Unread/attention counter fill on the bell and rail items.

tokens.name: on-badge
tokens.usage: Counter digits on badge.

tokens.name: mark-blue
tokens.usage: The logo blue as printed. Brand panels and illustration; use `brand` for interactive elements.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring (2px solid, 2px offset) on canvas and surfaces.

tokens.name: status-neutral-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icon of the neutral status. Created, work not started: draft, planned.

tokens.name: status-neutral-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the neutral pill and Gantt bar.

tokens.name: status-neutral-line
tokens.usage: Outline of the neutral pill and Gantt bar.

tokens.name: status-neutral-dot
tokens.usage: Indicator dot and bar edge of the neutral status.

tokens.name: status-progress-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icon of the progress status. Preparation under way: in work, ordered.

tokens.name: status-progress-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the progress pill and Gantt bar.

tokens.name: status-progress-line
tokens.usage: Outline of the progress pill and Gantt bar.

tokens.name: status-progress-dot
tokens.usage: Indicator dot and bar edge of the progress status.

tokens.name: status-ready-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icon of the ready status. Ready for the next step: ready for departure, confirmed.

tokens.name: status-ready-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the ready pill and Gantt bar.

tokens.name: status-ready-line
tokens.usage: Outline of the ready pill and Gantt bar.

tokens.name: status-ready-dot
tokens.usage: Indicator dot and bar edge of the ready status.

tokens.name: status-active-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icon of the active status. Happening now: in flight, arrived, service in progress.

tokens.name: status-active-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the active pill and Gantt bar.

tokens.name: status-active-line
tokens.usage: Outline of the active pill and Gantt bar.

tokens.name: status-active-dot
tokens.usage: Indicator dot and bar edge of the active status.

tokens.name: status-done-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icon of the done status. Finished successfully: completed.

tokens.name: status-done-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the done pill and Gantt bar.

tokens.name: status-done-line
tokens.usage: Outline of the done pill and Gantt bar.

tokens.name: status-done-dot
tokens.usage: Indicator dot and bar edge of the done status.

tokens.name: status-cancelled-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icon of the cancelled status. Withdrawn by a person: cancelled. Label is struck through in bars.

tokens.name: status-cancelled-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the cancelled pill and Gantt bar.

tokens.name: status-cancelled-line
tokens.usage: Outline of the cancelled pill and Gantt bar.

tokens.name: status-cancelled-dot
tokens.usage: Indicator dot and bar edge of the cancelled status.

tokens.name: status-critical-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icon of the critical status. Needs action now: AOG, vendor rejection, SLA breach, schedule conflict.

tokens.name: status-critical-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the critical pill and Gantt bar.

tokens.name: status-critical-line
tokens.usage: Outline of the critical pill and Gantt bar.

tokens.name: status-critical-dot
tokens.usage: Indicator dot and bar edge of the critical status.

tokens.name: status-warning-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icon of the warning status. Watch: low margin, deadline approaching, permit expiring.

tokens.name: status-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the warning pill and Gantt bar.

tokens.name: status-warning-line
tokens.usage: Outline of the warning pill and Gantt bar.

tokens.name: status-warning-dot
tokens.usage: Indicator dot and bar edge of the warning status.

tokens.name: row-critical
tokens.usage: Table row of a record in critical state (AOG, SLA breach). Only this and two other row tints exist.

tokens.name: row-seed
tokens.usage: Rows written by the demo generator (source=seed). Always paired with italic text and the seed tag.

tokens.name: demo-ink
tokens.usage: DEMO marker text and outline: the demo badge, DEMO stamp on exports.

tokens.name: demo-bg
tokens.usage: DEMO marker fill.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart categorical colour. Series 1: the primary measure. Use in this order; never reuse a status colour to mean a status in a chart legend.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart categorical colour. Series 2. Use in this order; never reuse a status colour to mean a status in a chart legend.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart categorical colour. Series 3. Use in this order; never reuse a status colour to mean a status in a chart legend.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart categorical colour. Series 4. Use in this order; never reuse a status colour to mean a status in a chart legend.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Chart categorical colour. Series 5 and "other". Use in this order; never reuse a status colour to mean a status in a chart legend.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and Gantt hour lines.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Login brand panel headline and marketing surfaces only. One per screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Dashboard greeting and empty-state headlines on large canvases.

styles.name: kpi
styles.usage: KPI tile values. Always with tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The H1 of every screen, in PageHeader. One per page.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Sub-sections inside a card, Gantt aircraft-type group rows, table group headers.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Client portal body text, login form, onboarding copy.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default for all internal screens: table cells, form values, descriptions.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text, the primary column of a table row, button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, table column headers, KPI labels, pill text.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text, meta lines under titles, timestamps in lists.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Rail group labels only. Set uppercase via CSS (text-transform: uppercase).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Flight numbers, tail registrations, ICAO/IATA codes, document numbers, Zulu times.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Labels inside Gantt bars, the Gantt hour scale, flight strip sub-lines.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pill inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card body padding in dense screens; form field gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gutter between cards, narrow-screen page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a page header and its content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; gap between dashboard sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major page regions.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Login panel padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Login brand panel outer padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Gantt bars, kbd hints, checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented control, rail items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdown menus, banners, flight strips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, KPI tiles, the Gantt board.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals, the command palette, the login form card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, counters, avatars, the DEMO badge.

tokens.name: shadow-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table header and sticky page header once scrolled.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, dropdowns, tooltips, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modals, drawers and the command palette. Cards never carry a shadow.

size.note: Fixed component dimensions. Density targets from theme.ts (32px controls) are kept.

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inputs: table toolbars, filters inside cards.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Default button, input and select height on internal screens.

tokens.name: control-h-lg
tokens.usage: Login form, client portal, command palette input.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Table row height (default).

tokens.name: row-h-compact
tokens.usage: Table row height in the compact density toggle.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Navigation rail, expanded.

tokens.name: rail-w-collapsed
tokens.usage: Navigation rail, collapsed (icons only).

tokens.name: gantt-row-h
tokens.usage: Gantt aircraft row height.

tokens.name: gantt-bar-h
tokens.usage: Gantt flight bar height.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Default icon size in controls and rail.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside pills, table cells and Gantt bars.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky headers and the Gantt now-line.

tokens.name: z-rail
tokens.usage: The navigation rail over content on narrow screens.

tokens.name: z-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers and dropdowns (matches Ant Design).

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and the command palette (Ant Design default).
